zones.shop.edit.viewer.hint: Show the shop the way the chosen team sees it: sections, subsections and items hidden from them disappear. Everyone means the full catalogue for editing.

zones.mark.menu.error.bad_id: Identifier takes latin letters, digits and _.+- only
zones.mark.error.too_many_lines: A label cannot hold more than %s lines!
zones.shopadmin.scope.hint: Whose stock a purchase spends. Shared is one for the whole server, team gives every team its own, personal gives every player their own.
zones.shop.scope.shared.hint: One stock for the whole server: a purchase lowers what is left for everyone.
zones.shop.scope.team.hint: Every team keeps its own stock. A player without a team buys from the shared one.
zones.shop.scope.player.hint: Every player keeps their own stock and their own restock timer.
zones.shopadmin.access.target.hint: The whole section, one department inside it, or a single item. Anything hidden from a team never reaches its players.
zones.shopadmin.access.everyone.hint: Turning this off leaves access to the teams ticked below. A section visible to one team is that team's own shop.
zones.shop.error.not_for_team: This item is not sold to your team
zones.shop.sell.hint: Sells everything in the inventory the sell module puts a price on. Purchases and gear are left alone.
zones.shop.error.no_move: '%s' is already at the edge of the list.
zones.shop.error.subsection_taken: This section already has a subsection '%s'.
zones.shopadmin.layout.target.hint: The section itself, a subsection inside it or an item. This order is the order players see.
zones.shopadmin.layout.home.hint: Moves the item between subsections. "No subsection" keeps it in the section itself.
zones.shopadmin.layout.host.hint: Moves it to another section. An item lands in the section itself, a subsection travels with its items.
zones.shopadmin.add_to.hint: The subsection the held item goes into. Subsections are created on the Create tab.
zones.mark.menu.kind.hint: A pin is a dot with a caption on the map and in the world. A label is text on the map alone: no dot, no plate, glowing in its own colour.
zones.mark.menu.marker_range.hint: How far away this mark is still shown in the world. Zero means the kind default.
zones.mark.menu.hide_radius.hint: Radius in blocks around the mark: inside it the mark leaves the HUD but stays on the maps. Zero means no zone.
zones.mark.menu.hide_shape.hint: A circle measures straight distance, a square the larger of the two axes.
zones.mark.menu.hide_height.hint: How many blocks above and below the mark the zone reaches. Zero means any height.
zones.mark.menu.hide_shown.hint: Draws the hide zone border as a wall and a ground ring, like bases and capture points. Only teams that see the mark see it.
zones.mark.menu.hide_color.hint: Color of the wall and the ring. "Same as mark" repaints the zone together with the mark.
zones.mark.error.no_world: The world %s of this mark is not loaded
zones.mark.menu.scale.hint: The size of the label on the map. It also changes with the mouse: arm the label with a double click and drag its corner.
zones.mark.menu.in_world.hint: Off - the mark stays on the minimap and the full map but is not drawn over the world
zones.mark.menu.label: Label
zones.shopadmin.add_pick.hint: Pick from the inventory (with all tags) or from all items, price right there
